about: How the model's `read` intent feeds the behaviour-profile counters (docs/01 §2, docs/02 §1.2). Keys of read_to_profile are the 17 read labels in doc order; values are counter bumps applied by GameState.apply_read(). `tone` marks the warm/cold polarity used for `inconsistency` (warm<->cold swings); reads absent from tone are neutral. Counters no read label maps to (control, apathy) are bumped by the keyword classifier via GameState.bump_profile().
